name: @zcode/epoch-arena-adapter
description: Arena expert loop and learnback: typed task packages with privacy-preserving (minimized/redacted) evidence exports, qualification metadata (scope/budget/deadline/acceptance), typed return packages validated on receipt, deterministic verification against acceptance criteria, canonical world-revision proposals, partial/rejected handling with typed reasons, independent reuse-rights decisions, and a pure simulated Arena endpoint. No execution authority.

scripts.test: tsc -b && node --test dist/test/fixtures.test.js dist/test/canonical.test.js dist/test/task.test.js dist/test/return.test.js dist/test/verify.test.js dist/test/revision.test.js dist/test/reuse.test.js dist/test/simulate.test.js dist/test/manifest.test.js
